catalyst.name: Debut Q2 2026 earnings (Aug 4, after close) + first IPO lockup unlock (Aug 6)
catalyst.status: SpaceX reports its first-ever quarterly earnings after the close on Aug 4, 2026. The report triggers the largest lockup unlock in market history: ~911.5M shares (~$116B at current prices, 20% of the 180-day block) become freely tradeable on Aug 6, the second full trading day after earnings. A bonus 10% tranche unlocks too if SPCX traded >=30% above the $135 IPO price for 5 of the prior 10 sessions - it has NOT (stock is currently ~$108, below the $135 IPO price), so that bonus tranche should not trigger. Further 7% tranches roll out Aug 31-Oct 25, full lockup expires Dec 8 2026. Stock is down ~26% since the Jul 11 log entry and is now trading below both the account's average cost ($171.12) and the original IPO price ($135).
